text:
Eleanor: Thanks for coming to the all-hands. Recording + slides: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/nov-2025. Leaving a short follow-up thread for Q&A and action items.

Marcos: Quick ask from infra: can leadership confirm the GA target for Private? I heard Q1 next year in the talk but want the exact month. @Eleanor

Eleanor: Targeting Feb 2026 for Private GA, pending SOC2 gating and partner validation. Will confirm in email.

Tess: On roadmap: when will per-model autoscale land? several product teams asked about weighting.

Eleanor: Per-model autoscale is on the roadmap for Q2 2026. We'll publish design doc in product board next month.

Devon: Action: I'll assemble a short one-pager for sales explaining GA vs beta differences for Private (data residency, support levels, pricing). Due end of week.

Aisha: Hiring follow-up: can we get the list of priority infra roles? hiring mentioned ramping up ops and infra.

Eleanor: Hiring priority: 2 infra SREs, 1 infra SW Eng (runtime), 1 security engineer for Private compliance. Recruiting will share JD links.

Marcos: Ops request: need a validation checklist for customers migrating to Dedicated. Can eng produce a checklist?

Devon: I'll draft a migration checklist (DB settings, KV priming, observability hooks). Will share in #eng by Wed.

Tess: Question from design: can we embed the performance benchmarks in Console as requested? product said yes during Q&A but need owner.

Eleanor: Product owns benchmarks page; Tess and Marcos to collaborate on what to surface. Action: Tess to draft mockups, Marcos to supply sample metrics.

all-hands-bot: Recording processed and transcript available at https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/nov25.

Aisha: Legal asked about export controls for Private deployments in APAC. Who should take point?

Eleanor: Security/legal will own export control review. @Aisha please coordinate with Legal and report back in 2 weeks.

Devon: Small thing: demo request from BizOps 1min runtime checklist for execs so they can answer RFP questions quickly. I'll make a 1-slide cheat sheet and share.

Marcos: Example deploy command we demoed in the all-hands:
```
rw deploy create --mode private --nodes 8 --model redwood-serve-v1
```

Eleanor: Summary of owners: Devon (sales one-pager + exec cheat sheet), Marcos (migration checklist + metrics), Tess (Console mockups), Aisha (legal export control liaison). Please update the follow-ups doc: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/followups-nov by EOD Fri. Ping me for blockers.

Tess: Thanks 60a

Marcos: :thumbsup:

Eleanor: I'll send a brief email with these owners and deadlines. Closing thread, add anything else to the sheet.
